name: singlet_covariate_adjustment_covariate_variance_attribution
title: Covariate variance attribution and confounding check
description: Estimates how much gene-level and principal-component variance each named covariate explains beyond the protected design, and flags covariates confounded with that design. Use before removing any covariate. The default pseudobulk_lmm method works on donor-by-cell-type pseudobulk. The tool writes shares and flags only, never a corrected matrix, so do not use it to correct expression.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

design.description: Protected biological design as a formula, for example ~ condition + cell_type. Always conditioned on.

covariates.description: obs columns to attribute, for example pct_counts_mt, cc_score, batch, donor.

layer.description: Count layer summed to pseudobulk for the mixed-model and association steps.

pseudobulk_by.description: obs columns defining one pseudobulk sample, the replicate unit for variance shares.

method.description: pseudobulk_lmm: per-gene mixed model (default); pcr: PC-level share; ols: per-gene regression share.

confounding_alpha.description: Nominal level of the donor-level covariate-design association test used for flags.

min_samples.description: Minimum samples per gene after filtering.

min_levels_per_random_effect.description: Minimum levels a random grouping needs before its variance is estimated.

n_pcs.description: Number of leading principal components used for the PC share.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. varm/<covariate>_vf. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_samples, n_genes_tested, median_partial_share per covariate, flagged_covariates, n_singular_fits.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
